professionalSummary: Program Manager with experience leading cross‑team authentication programmes, maintaining detailed plans and risk registers, coordinating security reviews, and synthesising customer feedback.
experienceHighlights: Ran the passkey sign‑in beta for 300 design‑partner accounts in the preview environment, leading the programme across identity, mobile and support teams.
Maintained the passkey programme plan and risk register, reviewing open risks at weekly meetings and keeping a decision log.
Booked and tracked the security architecture review and external penetration test of the passkey flows, closing 11 findings before beta launch.
Gathered beta feedback through fortnightly calls with design partners and a tagged feedback board, summarising top issues for the identity team each sprint.
Sent fortnightly status notes to the VP of engineering and the identity product lead covering milestones, risks and decisions needed, archiving past notes.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Beta programme plan for passkey sign‑in, covering design‑partner enrolment, preview‑environment configuration, feedback channels and exit criteria for the beta; its section on general availability lists open questions such as support staffing and rollout order.

They do not establish experience with a production launch of a platform feature.
